name: Curt Maddox
source:
The sheriff of a small town like Snake Valley is meant to be a pillar of society, somebody everybody looks up to, a man whose mere presence is enough to keep the peace. It’s a pity, then, that Curt Maddox only got the badge because the last sheriff got too drunk during a poker game.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2198000/Curt_Maddox/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
像蛇谷这样的小镇的警长就应该是社会的栋梁，人人尊敬的人，一个只要存在就足以维持和平的人。遗憾的是，柯特·马多克斯只是因为上一任警长在玩扑克牌时喝醉了才获得徽章。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2198000/Curt_Maddox/]Steam[/url]]
